cases.system_prompt: You are a data structures and algorithms tutor. Be concise and accurate.
cases.question: State the prerequisite and time complexity of binary search. Include the exact phrases 'sorted' and 'O(log n)'.
cases.review_note: Binary search requires ordered data and logarithmic comparisons.

cases.system_prompt: You are an algorithms tutor. Give hints before solutions and do not provide full code unless asked.
cases.question: Give one hint for Two Sum without code. Mention a hash map and complement.
cases.review_note: Must offer the O(n) hash-map direction without implementation.

cases.system_prompt: You are a programming tutor focused on correct debugging explanations.
cases.question: Why is a mutable default list dangerous in Python, and what should be used instead? Mention that it is created once and use None.
cases.review_note: Python evaluates defaults once and the normal repair uses None.

cases.system_prompt: You are a programming tutor. Explain bugs without unnecessary code.
cases.question: What happens when an async function call is missing await? Include the words coroutine and await.
cases.review_note: Must explain that calling returns a coroutine rather than its result.

cases.system_prompt: You are a cybersecurity tutor. Teach defensive concepts accurately.
cases.question: Is Base64 encryption? Include the exact words encoding, not encryption, and reversible.
cases.review_note: Base64 is reversible representation, not confidentiality.

cases.system_prompt: You are a cybersecurity tutor. Keep advice defensive.
cases.question: Name the primary defense against SQL injection. Include parameterized queries and separate data from code.
cases.review_note: Prepared/parameterized statements keep values out of SQL syntax.

cases.system_prompt: You are an FFmpeg tutor. Give exact flags and precise pipeline explanations.
cases.question: Explain why -c copy is fast. State that it avoids decoding and re-encoding and that it remuxes streams.
cases.review_note: Stream copy repackages compressed packets without transcoding.

cases.system_prompt: You are an FFmpeg tutor. Be precise about option placement.
cases.question: Contrast placing -ss before versus after -i. Include fast input seek and accurate output seek.
cases.review_note: Input seeking is fast; output-side decoding is typically more accurate and slower.

cases.system_prompt: You are a cinematography tutor using correct crew terminology.
cases.question: Contrast a dolly with a zoom. Include physical camera movement and focal length.
cases.review_note: Dolly moves camera position; zoom changes lens focal length.

cases.system_prompt: You are a film grammar tutor. Explain screen direction concretely.
cases.question: What does the 180-degree rule preserve? Include axis and screen direction.
cases.review_note: Cameras stay on one side of action axis to preserve spatial continuity.

cases.system_prompt: You are a Linux operations tutor. Explain commands safely and exactly.
cases.question: Decode chmod 755. Include owner rwx, group r-x, and others r-x.
cases.review_note: 755 gives owner 7 and group/other 5.

cases.system_prompt: You are a Linux operations tutor. Prefer graceful operational guidance.
cases.question: Contrast SIGTERM and SIGKILL. Include graceful, catch, and immediate.
cases.review_note: TERM is handleable; KILL is immediate and cannot be caught.

cases.system_prompt: You are an LLM architecture tutor. Explain inference internals accurately.
cases.question: What does the KV cache store and why? Include keys, values, previous tokens, and avoid recomputing.
cases.review_note: Cache retains attention K/V states for prior tokens.

cases.system_prompt: You are an LLM deployment tutor. Explain tradeoffs precisely.
cases.question: What is model quantization? Include lower precision, less memory, and quality tradeoff.
cases.review_note: Quantization reduces numerical precision and memory with possible quality cost.

cases.system_prompt: You are a patient math-for-AI tutor. Show small correct calculations.
cases.question: Compute the dot product of (2,3) and (1,4). Include 2×1, 3×4, and 14.

cases.system_prompt: You are a math-for-AI tutor connecting formulas to LLM behavior.
cases.question: What does softmax produce from logits? Include probabilities, sum to 1, and next token.
forbidden: probabilities can sum to more than 1
cases.review_note: Softmax normalizes logits into a probability distribution.

cases.system_prompt: You are a Vim tutor. Give exact standard keystrokes and accurate concise explanations.
cases.question: What does ciw do in Vim? Explain that it changes the inner/current word and that the cursor may be anywhere in the word.
cases.review_note: ciw changes the inner word independent of cursor position within it.

cases.system_prompt: You are a Vim tutor. Give exact keystrokes.
cases.question: What does dd do in normal mode? Include delete and current line.
cases.review_note: dd deletes the current line into a register.

cases.system_prompt: You are a vLLM inference tutor. Explain memory mechanisms accurately.
cases.question: Why does PagedAttention use blocks? Include non-contiguous, KV cache, and fragmentation.
cases.review_note: Paged blocks map logical KV cache to non-contiguous physical storage.

cases.system_prompt: You are a vLLM inference tutor. Explain scheduling accurately.
cases.question: What is continuous batching? Include add requests, remove finished requests, and GPU utilization.
forbidden: waits for the whole batch to finish
cases.review_note: Scheduler changes membership between decoding steps.

cases.system_prompt: You are an AI fundamentals tutor. Explain equations accurately and concisely.
cases.question: Why does gradient descent subtract the gradient? Include steepest increase, subtract, and learning rate.
cases.review_note: The gradient points uphill, so descent moves opposite it.

cases.system_prompt: You are an AI fundamentals tutor. Distinguish training performance from generalization.
cases.question: How do training and validation loss reveal overfitting? Include training loss falling, validation loss rising, and held-out data.
cases.review_note: Overfitting is diagnosed from divergence on held-out data.

cases.system_prompt: You help choose gifts from a saved recipient profile without inventing live shopping facts.
cases.question: What makes a useful gift recommendation? Include a specific item, recipient interests, occasion, and gift history.
cases.review_note: Recommendations should connect a concrete item to recipient evidence.

cases.system_prompt: You are a strictly local gift helper with no internet access.
cases.question: Can you verify a current price, stock, review score, or purchase link? State the local limitation and what needs a live source check.
cases.review_note: The local model must not fabricate live commerce claims.

cases.system_prompt: You are a quantum-computing tutor. Use precise state-vector language.
cases.question: For α|0⟩+β|1⟩, what are the measurement probabilities? Include |α|², |β|², and collapse.
cases.review_note: Computational-basis probabilities follow the Born rule and measurement changes state.

cases.system_prompt: You are a quantum-computing tutor. Correct science-fiction misconceptions directly.
cases.question: Can entanglement send information faster than light? Include no, local measurement statistics, and classical communication.
cases.review_note: Entanglement correlations do not enable signaling.

cases.system_prompt: You are a tutor for a from-scratch LLM app. Explain the training loss concisely and accurately.
cases.question: Before any training, the model spreads probability uniformly over its V-symbol vocabulary. What is this random-guessing baseline cross-entropy loss? Include that it equals ln(V) (the natural log of the vocab size) and that getting under it is the first proof of real learning.
cases.review_note: The uniform baseline loss is ln(V); training must get under it.

cases.system_prompt: You are a tutor for a from-scratch transformer LLM app. Explain attention mechanism details accurately.
cases.question: In this decoder-style transformer, what does the causal mask do? Include that position t may attend only to positions up to and including t (s <= t), and that its job is to stop a token from peeking at the future it is being asked to predict.
cases.review_note: The causal mask restricts each token to current and previous positions.
